name: LayoutRebuildHelper
src_typeComment: Fixes the classic Content Size Fitter "one-frame-behind" flicker: Unity defers layout rebuilds to end-of-frame by default, so a runtime content change (new text, an added child) visibly shows the OLD size for one frame before snapping to the new one. ForceRebuildImmediate walks the hierarchy children-first — a nested layout's children must resolve their own sizes before their parent can size correctly around them — and forces the rebuild synchronously instead of waiting.
